About Kingdom Adventurers Community Tools

Kingdom Adventurers Community Tools is a searchable reference site for jobs, equipment, shops, monsters, pets, events, maps, guides, and planning calculators.

Use it to compare job stats, check weapon and shield access, plan equipment exchange routes, find shop unlocks, follow event timers, and make better town progression decisions.

cards.title: Jobs and Profession Types
cards.body: Jobs and Profession Types Jobs/professions are the residents/allies of your town. There are three types of jobs. Battle-Type (18): Archer, Berserker, Champion, Guard, Guerilla, Gunner, Knight, Magic Knight, Monk, Ninja, Paladin, Pirate, Royal, Samurai, Santa Claus, Scholar, Viking, Wizard Traders (9): Artisan, Beast Tamer, Blacksmith, Cook, Doctor, Entertainer, Mage, Researcher, Trader. Traders can open shops when given a plot. Workers (7): Artist, Carpenter, Farmer, Merchant, Monarch, Mover, Rancher

cards.title: Skills and Skill Slots
cards.body: Skills and Skill Slots Each ally comes with skills based on the ally. These can be removed or changed freely. The number of skill slots depends on rank. Using the Skill Slot Up item grants the ally more skill slots. Children inherit skill slots from their parents. The maximum number of skills an ally can have is nine.

cards.title: Acquiring Allies
cards.body: Acquiring Allies Non-marriage allies can be acquired by rolling gacha using Job Trade Tickets or Diamonds. They can also be bought with Diamonds from Job Center Facility, some are acquired by unlocking the map, and finally you can breed by marrying first-generation allies. Marriage-exclusive jobs can only be acquired from marrying two first-generation allies. Scholar can be acquired through survey or from treasure crates. Monarch is a unique job, and you can only have one Monarch. Monarch rank increases as you level up your Town Hall.

cards.title: Ranks
cards.body: Ranks There are 6 ranks a job can have: S, A, B, C, D, and F. Stat growth per level is different for every rank. F rank is unique to Scholar.

cards.title: Level Cap and Growth
cards.body: Level Cap and Growth Allies have a level cap that is the same for all ranks. Different jobs have different max levels in every stat. Different jobs and different ranks have different growth values per level in every stat. Max level cap can be increased by awakening allies.

cards.title: Awakening
cards.body: Awakening Every 100 points of awakening grants the ally +30 max level in all stats. The max level of all stats is 999. Allies can be awakened by feeding them the same kind of job of any rank. You can only feed allies that have not yet been assigned to a town. Allies can also be awakened by feeding them scholars.

Jobs and Profession Types

Jobs/professions are the residents/allies of your town.

There are three types of jobs.

Battle-Type (18): Archer, Berserker, Champion, Guard, Guerilla, Gunner, Knight, Magic Knight, Monk, Ninja, Paladin, Pirate, Royal, Samurai, Santa Claus, Scholar, Viking, Wizard

Traders (9): Artisan, Beast Tamer, Blacksmith, Cook, Doctor, Entertainer, Mage, Researcher, Trader. Traders can open shops when given a plot.

Workers (7): Artist, Carpenter, Farmer, Merchant, Monarch, Mover, Rancher

Skills and Skill Slots

Each ally comes with skills based on the ally. These can be removed or changed freely.

The number of skill slots depends on rank.

Using the Skill Slot Up item grants the ally more skill slots.

Children inherit skill slots from their parents.

The maximum number of skills an ally can have is nine.

Acquiring Allies

Non-marriage allies can be acquired by rolling gacha using Job Trade Tickets or Diamonds.

They can also be bought with Diamonds from Job Center Facility, some are acquired by unlocking the map, and finally you can breed by marrying first-generation allies.

Marriage-exclusive jobs can only be acquired from marrying two first-generation allies.

Scholar can be acquired through survey or from treasure crates.

Monarch is a unique job, and you can only have one Monarch. Monarch rank increases as you level up your Town Hall.

Ranks

There are 6 ranks a job can have: S, A, B, C, D, and F.

Stat growth per level is different for every rank.

F rank is unique to Scholar.

Level Cap and Growth

Allies have a level cap that is the same for all ranks.

Different jobs have different max levels in every stat.

Different jobs and different ranks have different growth values per level in every stat.

Max level cap can be increased by awakening allies.

Awakening

Every 100 points of awakening grants the ally +30 max level in all stats.

The max level of all stats is 999.

Allies can be awakened by feeding them the same kind of job of any rank.

You can only feed allies that have not yet been assigned to a town.
